title: Armageddon dream with the number 747 and number cubes

tellings.quote: incredibly vivid dream in in the midst of all this at that Fort Knox where I dreamt that I was in a battle like a battle of Armageddon.

plain: In 1976 at Fort Knox, Kentucky, a former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says he had an "incredibly vivid dream" of fighting in something like the battle of Armageddon, a dream that featured the number 747 and cubes covered in numbers. He tells Michels about it as his own experience and also writes about it in his book A State of Mind: Faith and the CIA. He presents it as one of the strange experiences that he says shaped him.
